caption: The drawing depicts a doll with a human-like face, blue eyes, and short brown hair. The doll is dressed in a long, cream-colored dress with short sleeves that are puffed at the shoulders and gathered at the waist. The dress has visible folds and shading, giving the appearance of fabric texture and movement. The doll’s arms and legs are exposed, with the arms bent at the elbows and the hands positioned in front of the body, holding the dress. The feet are bare, with visible toes. The background of the image is plain and off-white, and the artist's signature "Mary Humes" appears near the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Wax Doll
